title: Northgate Optical Lab Handling Fee on Late Prescription-Change Remakes
content:
**Lab handling fee — late prescription-change remakes, Northgate Optical.**

| Other remakes on the job (besides the prescription-change remake) | Lab handling fee |
|---|---|
| two or more | none |
| exactly one | 4.95 |

Where the job carries two or more remakes besides the prescription-change remake, no lab handling fee is charged, and where it carries exactly one, the lab handling fee is 4.95. A job with no other remake is outside this card.

**Counting the other remakes.** The other remakes are the remake charge entries on the job whose remake reason is anything other than prescription change — non-adapt, lab defect, frame defect or accidental damage. Each such entry counts, whatever its amount.

### Illustrations (hypothetical jobs)

| Remake charge entries on the job | Other remakes | Lab handling fee |
|---|---|---|
| one non-adapt, one prescription change | 1 | 4.95 |
| one non-adapt, one lab defect, one prescription change | 2 | none |
| one prescription change only | 0 | outside this card |
| one frame defect at 0.00, one prescription change | 1 | 4.95 |
